title: About Our School
paragraph: Khamis High School traces its roots back to 1950, when it was established by the Omani community with the aim of providing education for Arab children. At the time, the school was known as Arab Boys High School, reflecting its original purpose and the community it was established to serve. Its establishment marked an important chapter in the history of education in the region and laid the foundation for the institution that would later become Khamis High School. As the years passed, the school underwent significant changes and was eventually taken over by the Government, becoming a government school. This transition opened the institution to a broader community while preserving the educational foundation upon which it was established. Through the years, Khamis High School has continued to develop as an institution dedicated to providing students with opportunities to learn, grow, and prepare for their future. Today, Khamis High School carries forward a history that spans generations. Building on its rich heritage, the school is committed to providing quality education while nurturing discipline, character, knowledge, and responsibility among its students. With a focus on academic development and the holistic growth of learners, Khamis High School continues to serve its students and community while looking toward the future.
